question:
Given below are four hill stations in India.

(P) Munnar

(Q) Coorg

(R) Mount Abu

(S) Dalhousie

Which of the following presents the correct order of their locations from South to North?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PQRS.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order of the given hill stations from **South to North:**

 
 
• **Munnar hill station:** Kerala
 
• **Coorg (Madikeri) hill station:** Karnataka
 
• **Mount Abu hill station:** Rajasthan
 
• **Dalhousie hill station:** Himachal Pradesh
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8021ffe89ef0b6e41d9a96103cefc6fec5354b6813c87754fc363c91b8f2c8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **Munnar:** 

 
 
• It is a famous hill station in** South India.**
 
• It is a part of the** Western Ghats mountain ranges.**
 
• It is located in the **Idukki district of Kerala.**
 
• It is situated at the confluence of **three mountain streams:**
 
 
• Muthirapuzha
 
• Nallathanni
 
• Kundala
 
 
 
• Munnar is famous for **Neelakurinji,** a rare plant that flowers only **once in twelve years.**
 
 
 
• **Coorg:**
 
 
• It is also known as **Madikeri hill station.**
 
• It is a part of the Western Ghats mountain ranges.
 
• It is referred to as **Scotland of India.**
 
 
 
• **Mount Abu:**
 
 
• It is a popular hill station of the **Aravali Range.**
 
• It is well known for its **Dilwara Jain Temple.**
 
• The highest peak of Mount Abu is** Guru Shikhar.**
 
 
 
• **​Dalhousie:**
 
 
• **​​ **Dalhousie is a hill station in **Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• The hill station is named after its founder **Lord Dalhousie, the British Governor-General in India.**
 
• The hill station is famous for **snow-capped mountains.**
 
 

f1:T
